question: In a certain code language, 'VALUE' is written as 'GWNCX' and 'PLANT' is written as 'VPCNR'. How will 'BRAIN' be written in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/15d4e688c8bdc2766cb74c67a7c0d12a85a1e60bc448f376b860b7949a5ae586.png] 

The logic followed here is:

'VALUE' is written as 'GWNCX'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f198cc85482377df584fb4b60b2a0c80d06b612344d06a72759e078609787140.png] 

And,

'PLANT' is written as 'VPCNR'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7ce7d90b05ecb3c148ab3fd6efa13cfd38dac4107224cba60dd0ca404e0d65a5.png] 

Similarly,

'BRAIN' be written as

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d2632a7a125d6076742455dba0586243e4012cc36779369d0ddf360068b9da6a.png] 

Hence, "Option 3" is the correct answer.
